g.text: Attachment OBS and openGauss responsibility split
No BLOB, BYTEA, Base64, URL, or credentials.
Rows are the cross-Pod directory and state authority.
DELETED rows remain as non-reusable ID tombstones.
Object keys are random and internal.
No public deterministic bucket or prefix contract.
File names never participate in object keys.
Pod memory contains bounded in-flight chunks only.
There is no local file, temporary directory,
authoritative Java Map, or complete file cache.
